title: clk'event and clk='1' idiom — Tier 4.1 DeferredAttribute regression fence
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: 4-bit counter using the pre-2008 `if clk'event and clk='1' then` idiom instead of `rising_edge(clk)`. Before Tier 4.1, clk'event was baked as a static Variable literal at synth time and never refreshed across process executions. With DeferredAttribute in place, this must produce the same VCD as the equivalent rising_edge(clk) form.
